description: A propositional formula has a natural-deduction derivation without open assumptions if and only if it is true under every Boolean valuation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.theorem_iff_tautology.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α]
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Derives ∅ A ↔ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Tautology A
